Jonas —

Quick read: 25% is outside auto-approve bands for pilot deals at this ARR level. Two options:
1) Reduce concession to 18% and use a 9-month payment cadence (likely approvable by Finance via delegated authority).
2) Keep 25% but route to Pricing Committee (adds ~3 business days).

If Finance confirms the deal can remain in forecast with staged payments, we can keep Stage = "Commit" and mark Deal Desk approval pending final doc sign-off. If not, please move it back to "Contract" until Pricing Committee completes review.

I updated the pricing worksheet with a pro-forma showing the 18% and 25% scenarios. See attached.

— Karthik
Deal Desk Manager

Attachment referenced: Pricing_Worksheet_Aurora.xlsx

Team —

Thanks for the context. Finance is comfortable treating the opportunity as forecast-eligible as long as both of the following are true:
- We capture a signed SOW/PO with a payment schedule in our billing system before we close the month (requested PO by 05/14 meets this).
- The effective net revenue impact is modeled as 18% concession (reforecast with the 18% scenario which Karthik provided).

Please do the following today:
- Jonas: update the HubSpot deal with the "18% concession" scenario and set stage to "Commit (conditional)" with a note: "Finance approval on 18% and PO by 05/14. Pricing Committee required for >18%."
- Karthik: send a short email to pricing-committee@redwood.com if Aurora insists on 25% so we can trigger the formal review (include the updated worksheet).

I will log the approval note in the finance ledger after I see the HubSpot update. If the customer provides a LOI, that can accelerate collection but won't change the concession band.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Finance
